items.name: Member effort discovery
items.description: Validate where members abandon or escalate registry, billing, and transfer workflows.
questions: Which registry workflow fields create the most evidence rework?
Where do members need examples before submitting a request?
Which billing questions can be resolved through clearer portal context?

items.name: Routing security safety discovery
items.description: Validate operator concerns that block safe ROA and RPKI adoption.
questions: Which ROA change scenarios feel too risky for operators?
What evidence does a peering team need before enabling validation?
Which training moments should be embedded into RPKI workflows?

items.name: Public data reuse discovery
items.description: Validate how researchers and policy participants use datasets, APIs, and analysis outputs.
questions: Which API changes or dataset gaps most often break external workflows?
Which caveats are most often missed when RIPE NCC data is cited?
Which policy proposals would benefit from standard evidence packs?
